name: GO Inc.
summary: GO Inc. provides app-based ride-hailing and various related services. The company's application offers real-time location information sharing, digitalization of operations for taxi companies, management service, and decarbonization services. It also provides mobility-related businesses, such as dispatch systems to taxi operators; and taxi-related services. GO Inc. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
